rootCause: Restore completion moves the saved entry from archives to locations. Cold loading correctly marks the operation unknown, but recheck_recycle only looked in archives and returned the old unknown result after successful restore.
change: When the archive entry is absent, only an exact dispatched restore with a persisted canonical SavedLocation can enter the new verification branch. It reuses complete verify_at checks plus explicit current HEAD/branch comparison, then compares the complete captured location and operation under the manager lock and saves both together through the existing metadata CAS.
safety: No move/delete/reset/new work is dispatched by recheck; historical conversation cwd remains unchanged
Failure publishes unknown and the actual fixed error code, retaining location identity and material

Newer canonical revision is usable at capture only if all substantive fields match. Any canonical/status/request/completed/recycle change during verification rejects the late result; a fresh explicit check uses current revision+1
No schema, DTO, ledger, frontend, Agent, permission or main-plan changes

before.scope: One missing branch, not four independent defects: normal cold restore stays unknown; directory/HEAD/material failures return old recheckRequired rather than a fresh verification result

coverage: Public manager create/archive/restore -> cold list/recheck -> ready, repeated through a second cold load; canonical/durable result, incremented revision, historical whole row and file bytes checked
Owned original directory replaced at same path: changed/unknown; displaced original and replacement remain untouched
HEAD changed in owned worktree: changed/unknown; no reset or material overwrite
File content changed after restore: materialChanged/unknown; changed bytes kept
Actual filesystem verification followed by actual check_location inside a controlled interleaving: late result cannot overwrite newer raw data; next fresh check succeeds with a higher revision
Actual filesystem verification followed by acknowledge inside a controlled interleaving: late result cannot clear reviewed unknown; exact newer raw data kept
boundaries: Actual tests used only their own temporary Git repositories and in-memory MetaStore. Two race cases are controlled interleavings, not an OS scheduling stress test
Author verification did not manipulate the formal App, start a real Agent, open user databases or run native UI
The installed 83cdf observation belongs to root. This source repair still needs integration and subsequent installed native recheck
Full verification intentionally refuses changed material/index/HEAD; no inference that arbitrary external activity stopped or that the old restore result proves current content unchanged
preparationNote: The initial output-only patch application check failed because the generated new-file diff omitted a new-file mode header. It was corrected before production application; that preparation error is not counted as a product red.
